newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Skala/Union Banka merger complete.
newsitem.headline: Czech Skala/Union Banka merger complete.

text.p: The Czech central bank said on Friday that it had agreed to officially end the licence of the privately-held Bankovni Dum Skala a.s., effictive on March 31, to complete Skala's merger with Union Banka a.s..

In a statement, the Czech National Bank said that Union Banka in 1996 had executed a financial restructuring of three banks -- Skala, Ekoagrobank, and Evrobanka -- through a merger of all the banks under Union Banka.
Union Banka's balance sheet stood at 22 billion crowns after the merger with 123 branches throughout the country.
Further details were not immediately available.
